min_version_student.description: Force-update: iOS Cue (student) versions below this show the Update screen. Empty = off.

min_version_staff.description: Force-update: iOS Cue Staff versions below this show the Update screen. Empty = off.

update_url.description: https App Store / TestFlight link for the Update button.

defaultValue.value: A new version of Cue is required to keep working with the counter.

announcement.description: Optional one-line banner shown at the top of both iOS apps. Empty = hidden.

ready_expiry_minutes.description: Minutes a ready order keeps its token. Clamped to 20..120 by the app: it can lengthen the limit, never shorten it (firestore.rules holds a token for 20 min).

stale_window_hours.description: Hours before an order is stale. Clamped to 4..24 by the app (firestore.rules uses 4 h).
